meta.source: Anthropic's public material (mood board, 119 pins, Nov 8 2026) as the base, with blind picks between candidates for what Anthropic leaves open.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The page: Anthropic's ivory by day, its warm near-black at night. Never pure white or pure black.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Quiet ground: code blocks, inline code, a band that sets a strip apart.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, flow cards and inputs: a warm white, never pure white, a step up from the paper.

tokens.name: fill-on-clay
tokens.usage: The fills of a drawing on a clay ground (hero blob or tile), in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-on-clay
tokens.usage: The lines of a drawing on a clay ground. Stays ink at night, so the clay patch reads like a printed sticker on the board.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines only: section rules, card borders, table rows. Never text.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen: inputs, chips, ghost buttons, table heads, chart axes (3:1 on paper and card).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, labels inside drawings and every brush stroke. On paper, panel, card, putty and sticky.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an `ink` fill: the primary button and a pressed chip.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text: ledes, paragraphs, card text. 4.5:1 or more on paper, panel, card, putty and sticky in both themes.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, sources, table heads, chart labels. 4.5:1 or more on paper, panel and card.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Clay as text and thin lines: hand notes, links, the recommended tag, focus rings, the 'con' dash. 4.5:1 on paper, panel and card.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Clay as a hover fill on the primary button (Anthropic's pressed clay).

tokens.name: on-accent-fill
tokens.usage: Text on `accent-fill`, used only at button size and weight.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Anthropic's clay. The hero blob, the quote mark, the loop arrow, the one bar that matters, a cross. Fills and big marks only, never text or a mark that carries meaning alone (2.96:1 on ivory, kept exact). It stays the same at night.

tokens.name: clay-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet clay ground: the clay pill and the input focus halo.

tokens.name: putty
tokens.usage: The one fill inside drawings (Anthropic's oat), and the plain pill.

tokens.name: sticky
tokens.usage: The sticky note's paper (Anthropic's manilla).

tokens.name: oat
tokens.usage: A quiet ground for a drawing's tile (Anthropic's oat). A printed colour: nearly the same by day and by night. Only ever a ground, never text or a control.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: The cool quiet ground for a drawing's tile (Anthropic's sage). Use it beside clay and oat so a row of tiles isn't one colour. Only ever a ground.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: State only: passed, done, a 'pro'. Always with a word or a mark.

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the good pill.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: State only: needs a look. Always with a word.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the warn pill.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: State only: failed, broken. Always with a word or a cross.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the bad pill.

tokens.name: s1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1, clay: the series or bar the chart is about. The same clay as everything else.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Chart marks that are not the point: other bars, other parts. Darker than putty so a bar is seen against the paper.

tokens.name: s2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2, sky.

tokens.name: s3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3, olive.

tokens.name: s4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4, fig. More than three series in one chart is a sign to split it.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Read the transcript before you trust the score
styles.usage: The page's h1, `ink`. clamp(34px, 4.6vw, 52px). A claim or a question, never a topic label.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: The one big number in a section, `ink`. Lining figures; a range takes an en dash.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: A grader turns an agent's run into a number. The number is only as good as what the grader read.
styles.usage: The paragraph under the title, `text`, at most 46ch, 10px below the title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Which tools it called, in what order, and where it went in circles.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Two good answers scored differently mean the task needs work.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: We do not take eval scores at face value until someone reads some transcripts.
styles.usage: Quoted words under the clay quote mark, `ink`.

styles.name: flow-label
styles.usage: Labels inside flow cards (SVG text at the 1000-wide viewBox), `ink`.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: A few handwritten words in `accent` with a brush arrow, pointing at one thing. Never a sentence, a heading or a label.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The uppercase label above a title or section, table heads, `muted`.

spacing.note: Real gaps from the pages. A page's sections sit 56px apart; the page pads 64px on top and 96px below.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap inside a note (arrow to words), between list items.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap inside a card's stack.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: A row of buttons or chips; label to title.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: A section's stack (`.sk-section`).

tokens.name: space-26
tokens.usage: Card padding and the gap in a grid of cards.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: The gap between the two halves of a hero or a two-column section.

tokens.name: space-56
tokens.usage: Between sections (`.sk-page`).

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of a page.

tokens.name: radius-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky notes: paper, nearly square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Code blocks and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and flow cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips and pills.

shadow.note: Paper lies flat. Only things that float above the page lift: the sticky note, and dialogs, toasts and tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-sticky
tokens.usage: The sticky note only. Never on cards.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Dialogs, toasts, tooltips and the compare handle: things that float. Never on a card that sits in the page.

brush.note: The hand. bundle.js draws every stroke as a filled, tapering shape from these.

tokens.name: brush-hero
tokens.usage: Base brush width (viewBox units) for a hero drawing.

tokens.name: brush-spot
tokens.usage: Base brush width for a spot drawing beside text.

tokens.name: brush-flow
tokens.usage: Base brush width for the spots inside flow cards.

tokens.name: brush-arrow
tokens.usage: Width of a flow arrow; a note's arrow is 2.6.

tokens.name: boil-frame
tokens.usage: The hero boils: a new hand-drawn version every 167ms (12fps on twos), three versions in turn.

tokens.name: stroke-draw
tokens.usage: Entrance: one brush stroke drawing itself along its centreline. Strokes follow each other in drawing order, at most 900ms for a whole drawing.

timing.note: Motion has four curves. Things arrive with ease-out, the pen draws with ease-draw, markers slide into place with ease-settle, and small things land with ease-pop. Nothing loops except the hero's boil, a live dot and a loader.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Text rising in, panels, meters and bars growing.

tokens.name: ease-draw
tokens.usage: A line drawing itself: strokes, chart lines, ticks, rings, timelines.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Things sliding into place with the slightest overshoot: the segmented thumb, the tab bar, the contents marker, switches.

tokens.name: ease-pop
tokens.usage: A small thing landing from nothing: a dot, a pin, a pill, a sticky note, a card lifting under the pointer. A touch past its place and back, never a bounce.

tokens.name: time-quick
tokens.usage: Hover and press: colour and border changes, a 2-3px lift.

tokens.name: time-move
tokens.usage: A marker sliding (tabs, segmented, contents), a value changing, a dialog opening.

tokens.name: time-enter
tokens.usage: A part rising 8px into view as it scrolls in, once.

tokens.name: reveal-stagger
tokens.usage: Between parts arriving together, in reading order; capped at five steps.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: `.sk-page` column: explainers, reports, decisions.

tokens.name: page-wide
tokens.usage: `.sk-page[data-width=wide]`: dashboards, viewers, tools with a side panel.

tokens.name: page-narrow
tokens.usage: `.sk-page[data-width=narrow]`: a long read, a quiz, a single form.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: `.sk-measure`: running text.

tokens.name: phone-break
tokens.usage: At or below it, a hero and a two-column section stack.
